decisions.reason: Particle therapy is a growing niche and the phantom supports the firm's strategic move toward a unified QA platform.
Small-volume ionization chambers are essential for modern small-field and stereotactic dosimetry applications.
The second small-volume chamber likely serves a distinct clinical need and complements the existing portfolio.
Standard clinical ionization chambers are core products with long lifecycles and steady demand.
Relative dosimetry chambers are required for routine QA and calibration in radiation therapy departments.
Thimble ionization chambers are widely adopted and compatible with established clinical protocols.
